title: docs: make the cheapest non-promo route the model primary
author: ElliotEtag

gist.summary: Updated the internal model-routing policy: the cheapest route at its normal price becomes primary, and its cost sets the model price. The next-cheapest route becomes fallback, using another provider where possible; a costlier fallback is flagged in the PR. Promotional pricing does not determine the primary or model price, except for routes billed at the provider’s live price. This is a follow-up to #17226.
